QuestInfo.name: Mu Lung Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Tae Sang in Mu Lung says that he knows the secret to staying warm during the winter. Go and see if you can learn the secret from him.
QuestInfo.1: Tae Sang of Mu Lung says that there is a way to stay warm by using a little magic. The secret scroll called 'Temperature Secret' contains the magic. He wants you to get the Temperature Secret, which can be obtained from Mu Lung monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Temperature Secret scrolls to Tae Sang. Tae Sang says that with training, he will be able to go through the winter without feeling cold.

0.0: Looks like you're freezing. Even so, don't hunch your shoulders like that. If you don't like the brutal winter, then how about learning the Temperature Secret? The masters of Mu Lung practice the Temperature Secret. Would you like to learn it, too?

yes.0: The Temperature Secret is a mystical technique to create heat from the friction of your body's energy. It's handy for surviving the cold, harsh winter. Interested? Collect the scrolls from the monsters of Mu Lung and come back to me.\n\n#b#i4032571# #t4032571# x 20

no.0: The Temperature Secret is a very useful skill.
